gfn03: When on, Strata removes the vector's direction from the model's internal state after each chosen layer. Both ready-made vectors point along the refusal direction of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, so the model refuses far fewer requests.
gfn04: Removing refusals removes a safety behaviour. You are responsible for what the model writes with it on.
gfn05: It also shifts the model's predictions slightly on ordinary text. The authors of the built-in vector measured 0.2–0.4% more time per token on the same text.
gfn06: Made for the original Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. Both ready-made vectors fall under the Qwen Community License 1.0.
gfn07: Takes effect the next time the model loads. In a chat, the sampling settings can switch it off for a single answer.
gfn08: The author of the Huihui vector wrote: “I tested layers 4-44 and 1-47.” “I did not test Q2_0 or IQ3_XXS, harder refusal sets, real photos or documents in vision, more than one GPU, or AMD cards.” “Ten prompts is a small set.”
